Suffers a -1 penalty to all attack throws in full sunlight.
Can breathe and move underwater. Swim speed 120'/40'.
Regenerates 3 hit points each round unless damage is from fire or acid. Cannot be permanently destroyed except by fire or acid. Returns from 0 hp.
Severed limbs crawl back to the main body and can be reattached instantly.
Character hearing the song must save vs. Spells or be charmed. Charmed victims move toward the harpy and make no attacks. Successful save grants immunity for the rest of the encounter.
Senses blood in water to 300'. When blood is detected, fights to the death with no morale check.
Characters encountering submerged crocodiles suffer a -2 penalty to surprise rolls.
In animal or ratman form, immune to all attacks from normal (non-magical, non-silver) weapons.

A creature that loses 50% or more of total hit points to lycanthrope natural attacks contracts lycanthropy. Transformation in 2d6 days. Humans become lycanthropes; demi-humans die after 2d6 days. Cure disease works only before full onset.
Characters encountering wererats suffer a -2 penalty to surprise rolls.
May assume intermediate ratman form. Can use weapons and humanoid speech while retaining animal-form AC and weapon immunity.
Can summon 1d2 giant rats; they arrive in 1d4 rounds.
When killed, reverts to human form.
Bite is venomous. Victim must save vs. Poison or die after 1 turn.
Can spin webs with the same properties as the Web spell.
Sting is venomous. Victim must save vs. Poison or die.
If either claw successfully strikes, the sting attack receives a +2 bonus to its attack throw.
